text:
deploy-bot: Canary deploy v2026.06.01-rc1 to eu-west-1 completed. Running post-deploy smoke: echo-struct, warmup-heartbeat, func-call-sanity. Observed 9/120 failing probes (7.5%) — echo-struct returns malformed JSON for some samples.

sam: huh, saw alerts for structured-output mismatch. A subset of synth assertions failing: missing `response.metadata.model_variant`.

lina: that metadata field is new in structured-v2. Did we accidentally route requests to structured-v2 without the consumer flag?

synth-watchdog: failing probe details: 9 probes returning 200 but body parse error: `unexpected token '}' at line 1`. Hosts: eu-w1-gpu-02, eu-w1-gpu-05, eu-w1-gpu-09.

qa: reproducing locally with canary traffic shape: sending `POST /v1/generate` with header `X-Canary-Model: structured-v2` yields truncated JSON ~40% of the time under concurrency 8. Logs show `write: short write` in runtime output.

sam: decision tree: 1) pause rollout and pin hosts back to structured-v1, 2) reduce canary to 0% (roll back canary entirely), 3) keep canary but disable structured schema enforcement in smoke for now. I lean to pausing on affected hosts and holding rollout.

lina: +1 to pin affected hosts. This looks like a runtime flush/truncation under concurrent streaming. Pinning is surgical.

release-manager: change window is open for 45m. Pinning would be fast and keeps the rest of the cluster on canary. If we see widespread corruption, escalate to full rollback.

qa: suggested commands: `deploy-bot pin-hosts --hosts eu-w1-gpu-02,05,09 --model structured-v1 --reason "postdeploy structured-v2 truncation"` and `deploy-bot modify-rollout --model structured-v2 --canary 1 --note "reduced canary while triage"`.

deploy-bot: Executing pin command... Completed. Hosts will switch to structured-v1; estimated finish 30s. Also set canary to 1%.

synth-watchdog: schedule recheck +90s for echo-struct assertions and func-call-sanity.

(90s later)
synth-watchdog: recheck: failing probes reduced to 0/120. parse errors cleared. func-call-sanity passed.

lina: good. Next steps: runtime team to reproduce streaming truncation with structured-v2 under load and check flush/encoding buffers. I'll open RW-1724 with logs and heap traces.

sam: QA will run a 10m soak at 1% canary with concurrency matrix (1,4,8) and post results. If no regressions, we can attempt a controlled ramp with a streaming throttle flag.

release-manager: note for release notes: "Canary for structured-v2 temporarily reduced and three hosts pinned to structured-v1 after smoke tests detected intermittent structured output truncation. Investigation ongoing; no customer impact observed."

qa: adding gating step to post-deploy smoke: include structured-output parse check with streaming load for at least 5m.

sam: thanks everyone. I'll coordinate with runtime for a patch; aim to re-enable canary after RW-1724 findings.
